Why Brighton needs BeTranslated

Brighton, known for its iconic pier, creative energy, and vibrant cultural scene, is a dynamic coastal city with a rich history of international connections. 

As one of the UK’s most diverse cities, Brighton is a hub for tourism, education, and business, attracting people from all over the world.

With a population that includes a significant number of non-native English speakers and international students from the University of Sussex and the University of Brighton, BeTranslated provides specialised translation services in Brighton where the need for professional translation services is on the rise. 

From supporting global tech companies in the Brighton Digital Festival to facilitating international events at venues like the Brighton Centre, clear communication matters to the city’s thriving industries.

At BeTranslated, we know Brighton well and provide the best service to meet the needs of its multicultural community and growing business sector and our translation services help people communicate clearly in any language.

If you’re based in Brighton, Portsmouth, Southampton, or London, at BeTranslated, we understand the power of words.

With over 20 years of experience and a skilled team of translators, we are proud to support Brighton’s thriving economy by providing the highest quality translation services.

Translation services in Brighton

Legal translation services Brighton

Brighton’s legal sector is increasingly working with international clients, making accurate and professional legal translations essential. 

For international contracts or cross-border legal matters, BeTranslated provides expert legal translation services in Brighton, covering everything from court documents to business contracts.

Our certified legal translations meet both UK and international legal standards, including if you’re handling matters involving French, Spanish, or German-speaking clients.

Whether you need notarised translations or certified translation services, we have the expertise to help you with Brighton’s legal system.

Medical translation services

As a city known for its healthcare institutions, including the Royal Sussex County Hospital and several private clinics, Brighton attracts international patients and healthcare professionals.

Accurate medical translation services are essential for patient safety and effective care.

At BeTranslated, we specialise in translating medical records, patient consent forms, and clinical reports, so healthcare providers and patients can communicate clearly.

Our certified translations guarantee accuracy and confidentiality in every document, helping Brighton’s healthcare sector serve a global community.

Technical translation services

Brighton’s growing reputation as a hub for digital technology and innovation makes technical translation services a critical need for businesses.

From tech startups in the North Laine to established engineering firms, BeTranslated provides precise translations of user manuals, technical specifications, and software interfaces.

Our specialised translators make sure your technical documents are accurate and easy to understand, helping Brighton-based companies expand into global markets. We provide expert translations in multiple languages, including Mandarin and Arabic.

Business translation services

Brighton’s business scene is booming, with companies in industries such as technology, tourism, and creative arts thriving in the city.

If you’re a local business looking to reach international clients or a global company establishing a presence in Brighton, effective business translation services are essential.

BeTranslated offers business translation services so that your marketing materials, contracts, and websites communicate effectively across borders. If you’re targeting international tourists or expanding your business globally, our expert team is here to help.

Multilingual SEO and localisation services

A strong online presence matters for businesses looking to expand. Our multilingual SEO and localisation services in Brighton help companies rank higher in international search engines and resonate with global audiences.

If you’re competing in the bustling Brighton Marina or the trendy North Laine, BeTranslated can optimise your website for various languages, including Portuguese, Italian, and Korean.

We help businesses expand their reach beyond Brighton’s borders, so your digital content is accessible and engaging worldwide.

Document translation services Brighton

At BeTranslated, we offer comprehensive document translation services in Brighton, handling everything from business contracts to personal documents such as birth certificates and diplomas.

Our certified translations meet UK and international standards, so your documents are legally recognised.

For certified translations for legal purposes or translations of academic records, BeTranslated meets all accuracy and compliance requirements.

Interpretation services in Brighton

Brighton’s international community and events calendar create a high demand for professional interpretation services.

From business meetings to healthcare appointments, BeTranslated provides expert interpretation services in Brighton, keeping communication clear across multiple languages.

Our interpreters are fluent in a wide range of languages, and can provide both simultaneous and consecutive interpretation services for any setting.

Whether you need interpretation for a legal case or an international conference, our interpreters keep communication clear.

Why choose BeTranslated?

At BeTranslated, we pride ourselves on being a trusted provider of translation services in Brighton, offering high-quality translations across sectors.

Our team of certified translators are experts in their fields, giving you accurate, culturally sensitive translations that fit your needs.

With over 20 years of experience, we are committed to delivering fast and reliable translation services to businesses and individuals across Brighton.

BeTranslated handles certified translations, medical translations and multilingual SEO services, along with your other language needs.

If you’re based in the city centre, Hove, or Southampton, BeTranslated is here to support your translation and interpretation requirements.

Frequently asked questions

Do you translate creative and marketing content for Brighton businesses?

Yes, we adapt advertising, websites and brand copy so the tone and cultural references work for your audience.

Our translators write in their native language, which helps your message sound natural.

Can you provide certified translation in Brighton?

Yes, we supply certified translations with a signed statement of accuracy.

Tell us who needs the document, such as a solicitor, the Home Office or a university.

Do you translate legal documents for Brighton solicitors?

Yes, we handle contracts, witness statements, court papers and other legal material.

Translators with legal experience work on these files, and a second linguist reviews them.

Can I send documents securely from Brighton?

Yes, you can upload files online, and we keep them confidential.

Ask us if you need extra steps, such as a non-disclosure agreement.

Which languages can you cover for Brighton clients?

We cover a wide range of languages, including those spoken in the city's creative, tech and student communities.

Send us your language pair and we will confirm the best translator for your subject.
